reviews.title: Bring back one time purchase
reviews.text: This app was recommended to me by a friend and the reviews say that unlimited walking is a one-time payment. However I don’t see that option, and have a limit of 0.5 miles a day unless I watch an ad every mile. I love the design and concept of this app but I’m not going to pause and watch an ad every mile, so I’m going to delete it. I would love to make a one-time purchase just for unlimited walking with no other benefits, but I’m afraid it’s a dealbreaker!

reviews.title: This App kept me going!
reviews.text:
5stars!  Get the full version!  The free one only lets you record 1 mile a day. 
I was trying to walk 10,000 steps a day. Then a friend showed me this app. So even on the days I didn’t get 10,000 steps I still moved forward on the quest to Mount Doom!
I loved how you could pick a character to race against!
Did it in 346 days

reviews.title: Fun motivation!

reviews.title: New respect for Hobbits…
reviews.text: I am definitely not someone who walks a ton, but this is so much fun to reach milestones and see how the landscape changes that I check it every day to see how much closer I have gotten to Mount Fire. Mr Underhill totally kicked my butt - though he did have the benefit of not needing to do anything all day other than walk!

reviews.title: Fun, Simple, Charming
reviews.text: No multiple currencies, no forcing you to pay attention, no need to have your phone with you when you walk, just a very charming stroll to Mount Doom. I love that the distance is achievable, but also a long effort.  Hopefully, I will also lose weight before I deal with the ring.

reviews.title: Innaccurate and burdensome

Its an amazing app and would be alot of fun if it were accurate but im getting sick of walking 14,000 steps and it telling me i walked 2 miles because the only app that it pulls data from is apple health which is complete garbage and for some reason doesnt track distance correctly.

Wish they would allow you to tether zepp app or fitbit app

reviews.title: Motivating
reviews.text: It’s fun! I bought the unlimited distance pack and recommended it to two friends who joined and did the same! I wish you would be able to see at least the total distance of your friends when you buy the unlimited distance pack. I get it’s not the sub so you don’t see all the stats, but just the total distance would make it so much easier to celebrate big milestones with each other and egg each other one. Which is why it’s four instead of a full five stars. Still beautiful art and nice user interface.

reviews.title: Stopped tracking distance
reviews.text: This seemed like a really cute app that would’ve made my walks more exciting, if it didn’t stop randomly tracking the distance. I had to restart my journey a few times for it to start tracking again. Walked about 2 miles and it said I only had walked 1. Not sure if it’s a user issue or an app issue, but I couldn’t keep using it.

reviews.title: A fun journey

reviews.title: I Love this app
reviews.text: This app is one of the best in the world, it’s awesome and I like the lord of the rings theme. I’ve just started and I’ve only got 554ft so far but I will get there eventually. But I LOVE this app thank you soooo much for making it.

reviews.title: Refreshing
reviews.text: Thank you SO much for having it set to one single payment and not a monthly subscription. And for no ads. I can’t express how exhausted I am of the price gouging. I miss when we had to pay for apps honestly, I’d rather that than the monthly. So so refreshing to just pay once and be done. Wish I could add friends to play against with that payment is the only negative thing I have to say.

reviews.title: Could be better

reviews.title: Too pricy for what it offers
reviews.text: App works great, I’m really enjoying playing with it along with my friends (we all got it together), but I do think it merits 4 stars given how pricy it is. If it was a one time purchase, I’d rate it 5 stars, but given that it operates as a SaaS app, I think it’s a bit costly,

reviews.title: A fun challenge
reviews.text: I’m on my third walk to Mount Fire. I paid for the one time purchase, unlimited miles per day and it’s been worth it. The app keeps pace with a similarly named character from the most popular fantasy series of all time, so getting to race “Mr. Underhill” on his adventure has been fun. He beat me this time but I’m sure I’ll get him next time. Tracking is fairly consistent with my Apple Watch distance tracking, i think it might be more accurate at times. Definitely worth spending 5 bucks or whatever it was for unlimited miles!

reviews.title: Pretty good
reviews.text: It’s really cool to see how far you’ve gone, but i wish you didn’t have to pay

reviews.title: Disappointed but not too surprised
reviews.text: Used to be a fun way to keep track of miles. I got it for the first time a couple years back, and I enjoyed it and it motivated me to walk a bit more. I never had to pay for anything and it tracked however much miles I had walked that day. It took me a long time, but I reached the end and forgot about it. I decided to get it again this year, cause I thought why not, just to find that theres a 1 mile limit, and you have to pay to track more than I mile. Doesn’t seem to be any new content either to warrant the need to charge for money. Disappointed but not surprised. Greed is getting to everyone these days I guess.
